title: Feature delivery (example)
summary: An implementer and an independent reviewer for a small technical change.

blueprints.title: Feature delivery
blueprints.summary: Plan, implement, then independently review a bounded change.

roles.name: Implementer
roles.purpose: Build the scoped change and report verifiable evidence.
roles.runtime_instruction: Implement only the approved scope. Run relevant checks and report evidence.

roles.name: Independent reviewer
roles.purpose: Assess the submitted work without inheriting the implementer's context.
roles.runtime_instruction: Review the exact submitted revision. Record evidence-backed approval or requested changes.
